name: volhlth
label: Done volunteer work in health past 12 mnths

questions.text:
Listed on this card are examples of the many different areas in which people do volunteer activity. By volunteer activity I mean not just belonging to a service organization, but actually working in some way to help others for no monetary pay. In which, if any, of the areas listed on this card have you done some volunteer work in the past twelve months? (DON'T READ. RECORD BELOW UNDER VOLHLTH-VOLOTH. CIRCLE "YES" OR "NO" FOR EACH AREA)
